No! I am devoted only to you!

включать.gloss: to turn on, to plug in

meanings.en: to switch on, to plug in

examples.text: Он всегда включает свет на кухне.
examples.trans: He always switches on the kitchen light.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: to a loved one, and at the start of letters

examples.text: Его руки немного дрожат от усталости.
examples.trans: His hands are shaking a bit from exhaustion.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: красная икра = red (salmon) caviar, чёрная икра = black caviar

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

meanings.note: as a reply on its own

плевать.gloss: not to care, couldn't care less (+ dative)

meanings.en: couldn't care less, don't care (colloquial predicative: мне плевать на + accusative)

examples.text: Если тебе плевать на дочь, то мне нет!
examples.trans: If you don't care about our daughter, I do!

meanings.en: half a kilogram, half a kilo

examples.trans: Buy half a kilo of cheese.
